value.rationale: The anti-invariant E8(-2) lattice is canonical for the Nikulin quotient, while paired rational curves are the most concrete anti-invariant classes in this explicit family. Determining that they span rationally but fail integrally by exactly index two is a natural structural invariant connecting the visible curve configuration to the hidden integral K3 lattice. The result is therefore more than a graph relabeling or orbit census and is directly useful for lattice and quotient calculations.
